description: The coordination step of the morning fails: typing "@Dev Patel and @Otter …" shows "@Dev and @Otter match no Actor and won't notify anyone." Profiles, the People dialog and avatars never show the handle needed (human-<uuid>, agent-<hex>-<harness>), so a browser user cannot mention a teammate they can see is on the task. The comment posts as plain text.
expected: @-mention by visible name with autocomplete, or the handle shown in the profile with a copy button.
actual: Warning, no notification, no way to discover the handle in the browser.
suggested_fix: Add @ autocomplete over the actor list (insert the handle, display the name), or accept display names.

description: With the hub stopped, Dev's replica shows "Remote presence unavailable" but still labels every avatar "…, offline" (including Dev himself) and the sync line keeps reading "Saved locally · synced" 15 s later.
expected: Avatars show an unknown/neutral state with labels like "presence unknown", and the sync line says the hub is unreachable.
actual: Everyone reads offline; sync line claims "synced".
suggested_fix: Render presence as unknown when the snapshot is unavailable; update the sync line from the hub link state.
